about_the_game: The financial boom and growing consumer behavior taking place in the Tycoon cities have drastically changed consumer habits within the population. This pack brings you 10 extra ornamental buildings that will embellish your city centers: Security Fence Section, Security Fence Corner, Safety Fence Gate, Covered City Center, Searchlight, Carousel Display, Shopping Mall Entrance, Shopping Mall Corridor, Shopping Mall Corner, and Shopping Mall Intersection.
